# Congested synthetic saves

The original five fixtures were generated by `tests/traffic-soak.mjs` from the engine snapshot SHA-256 `916e2f378075df1fa064533ffe85873ab351cebb9f9f75926802e29979cff637`. They contain no user save data.

All use an 8×8 restaurant, eight workers, three stocked foods, level 30, unlocked recipe mastery, and seed 67291. The 8/12-seat basic layouts ran for 1800 game seconds; the 4/8/12-seat clutter layouts ran for 3600 seconds. Clutter adds jars at (0,4) and a bonsai at (3,6).

`node tests/traffic-recovery.mjs` validates and reloads these snapshots plus the additional fractional-idle snapshot, observes every original guest leaving, and then continues for one hour to catch later deadlocks. Runtime WeakMap traffic state is intentionally absent, as it is after a normal saved-game reload. Per-minute arrivals, exits, sales and individual leaving durations are written to `artifacts/traffic-recovery/`.

Fresh-layout reproduction: `SOAK_SECONDS=3600 node tests/traffic-soak.mjs` and `SOAK_SECONDS=3600 SOAK_CLUTTER=1 node tests/traffic-soak.mjs`. Use a separate `SOAK_OUTPUT` for each run.

`12-seats-clutter-fractional-idle-final.json` is an additional snapshot produced by intermediate engine `14c3ff58e6971c4bd578804355527a57865350c17ba5c7e5493757a3e55080d7` after reloading the 12-seat clutter save and advancing another hour. Worker o40 is idle at (1,5.3) with an empty path after a service cancellation, permanently occupying two transit tiles in that version. It checks recovery of already-saved fractional idle positions as well as prevention of new ones.
